reviews.name: Lake Tahoe Visitors Authority Marketing Services Committee
reviews.issue: LTVA's Marketing Services Committee ("Ad-Hoc") meets most months on a Wednesday morning; its events on the LTVA calendar link a discussion-topics or items PDF rather than a numbered agenda.
reviews.nextStep: Keep live discovery without an agenda layout. Add a schedule if the committee settles on a regular pattern; in 2026 it skipped several months.

resolution.note: Live captures of the October 7 and November 4, 2026 meetings stored the posted documents' text. Their formats differ from month to month and one January file extracts only as unreadable characters, so no layout reads items.

reviews.implementation: A full entry (not `extends`, since it has no agenda block) on the `tribe-events` type with its own title pattern.

reviews.name: South Lake Tahoe Tourism Improvement District Board of Directors
reviews.issue: The SLTTID board meets about six times a year. Its own website (a GoDaddy site) lists agendas, minutes, and notices as download links labeled "Download"; recent agendas are Word files named with the meeting date ("TID Agenda 10.29.2026.docx", "TID Special meeting 9-24-26 (002).docx"). The same page holds a 2023 South Lake Tahoe Lodging Association agenda and the April 30, 2026 joint workshop agenda.
reviews.nextStep: Keep live discovery. Minutes files are not linked to meetings yet. The joint workshop and the lodging association's agendas are left out (see the note below the table in source-review.md).

resolution.note: The page and its downloads answered the project's user agent on 2026-11-09. Live captures of the August 27, September 24 (special), and October 29, 2026 Word agendas read 18, 15, and 16 items once Word's list numbering is rendered into the text. Meetings have no regular schedule.

reviews.implementation: A new `file-links` discovery type (tahoe_ingest/file_discovery.py) reads dated download links on a page; capture reads Word (.docx) files by file type (tahoe_ingest/docx_source.py). The `slttid-board` layout reads the two lettered lists; `slttid-special` reads the special meeting format, whose typed item numbers are not kept as labels.

reviews.name: Tahoe Truckee Unified School District Board of Education
reviews.issue: The district's only agenda source, its iCompass portal at ttusdpub.ic-board.com, answers HTTP 403 to the project's user agent (checked 2026-11-09); ttusd.org links nothing else that lists meetings.
reviews.nextStep: Keep the board in the registry with a coverage note and no discovery; retry if the portal starts answering the project's user agent.

resolution.note: The maintainer chose to list the board with a note, as for Placer County, rather than leave it out.

reviews.name: Truckee Fire Protection District Board of Directors
reviews.issue: The Truckee Fire Protection District (fire protection, wildfire prevention, evacuation, fire code, and development fees for Truckee and parts of Nevada and Placer counties) posts each board agenda packet on its Squarespace website. Its board meeting archive page prints one paragraph per meeting, the meeting date followed by "Agenda" and "Minutes" links, and its board meetings page links only the current agenda.
reviews.nextStep: Keep live discovery from the archive page. The archive row for a meeting appeared with its agenda for every 2026 meeting checked, but the November 17, 2026 agenda was not yet posted on 2026-11-13, so how soon a new row appears is not yet observed; if upcoming agendas show up only on the board meetings page, read that page's current agenda link as well. The board meetings page lists no livestream or recordings, so no recording feed is configured.

resolution.note: The archive page and its agenda files answered the project's user agent on 2026-11-13 (the files redirect to static1.squarespace.com). It lists 11 meetings in 2026, including two canceled ones (February 17 and May 19, each linking its notice) and a February 20 special session. Live captures of the June 16 to October 20, 2026 meetings read 32 to 49 items each. The board meetings page gives the schedule: the third Tuesday at 5:30 PM in the Truckee Sanitary District board room, 12304 Joerger Drive; every 2026 meeting fits (a 2024 agenda and a news report of a Thursday schedule are out of date).

reviews.implementation: A new `dated-paragraphs` discovery type (tahoe_ingest/page_discovery.py) reads each paragraph that opens with a date, takes its link labeled "Agenda" as the document and "Minutes" as its minutes, ignores the stray empty links the page editor left in most paragraphs, gives a special session its own ID, and marks a paragraph saying "Cancelled" as a canceled meeting whose official URL is the notice. The `truckee-fire-board` layout reads the agenda pages at the front of the packet (numbered sections, lettered items, attachment numbers in a right-hand column). Staff reports are attachments in the packet, headed by agenda title with no item number; no rule reads them yet.

reviews.name: North Tahoe Fire Protection District Board of Directors
reviews.issue: The North Tahoe Fire Protection District (Tahoe City, Kings Beach, Alpine Meadows, and the West Shore, including the former Meeks Bay Fire Protection District, annexed January 1, 2025) now runs ntfire.net on Squarespace; its /wp-json answers HTTP 404, so no WordPress discovery type applies. Its board agendas page is a Squarespace blog with one post per meeting, titled "Regular Meeting 10-2026" (a month, not a date) and linking the agenda PDF and, once approved, the minutes. Posts for every 2026 meeting through the canceled November 3 meeting are there.
reviews.nextStep: Keep live discovery from the blog's JSON. A post's title gives only the month, so capture dates each meeting from its agenda's first page, as for WordPress meeting posts. The Meeks Bay board's archive page (to December 2024) is not read, and the board agendas page lists no livestream or recordings.

resolution.note: The collection JSON and agenda files answered the project's user agent on 2026-11-13 (the files redirect to static1.squarespace.com). Live captures of the July 28, August 25, September 22, and October 27, 2026 meetings took their dates from the agendas and read 7 to 28 items; the November 3 cancellation notice dated the canceled meeting. The staff report rule linked 19 items of those meetings to their memos. The board agendas page gives the 2026 schedule: the fourth Tuesday at 3:00 PM, except May (third Tuesday), November (first Tuesday), and December (second Tuesday), at Station 51, 222 Fairway Drive, Tahoe City; the October agenda's "Next Board Meeting" memo lists December 8, 2026 and January 26, 2027.

reviews.implementation: A new `squarespace-blog` discovery type (tahoe_ingest/blog_discovery.py) reads the collection's `?format=json` pages, one candidate per post with its linked agenda or cancellation notice and minutes; posts without a full date are bounded by count in scheduled runs (`UNDATED_TYPES`). The `north-tahoe-fire-board` layout reads numbered items, "13.1" report sub-items, and lettered parts. A new `agenda-item-memo-links` staff report rule follows the LINKED agenda's link annotations to files named for the item number and checks the memo's "AGENDA ITEM #N" subject line.

reviews.name: Tahoe Forest Hospital District Board of Directors
reviews.issue: Requested on 2026-11-13: the hospital district's elected board, which meets in Truckee and is livestreamed by Tahoe Truckee Media. Its minutes and agendas page (WordPress) links every board, committee, joint, and Truckee Surgery Center document; each link is labeled with the body, the date, and the document ("Regular Meeting of the Board of Directors – 10/22/2026 – Agenda Packet"), while the uploaded file names are loose ("2026-4-23-...", "Thursday-Nov-21-agendas.pdf").
reviews.nextStep: Keep live discovery of the board's regular and special meetings. Board committees (Finance, Governance, Quality, Community Engagement, Executive Compensation) publish agendas in the same format and could be added as sibling entries if the maintainer asks; joint meetings with the Town of Truckee and the surgery center's board of managers are left out. No staff report rule reads the packet yet.

resolution.note: The page and its PDFs answered the project's fetcher on 2026-11-13 (curl from the same sandbox got HTTP 403 from the site's Cloudflare edge, so a curl fallback would not help if urllib ever fails). Live discovery found 14 board meetings in 2026 (10 regular, 4 special); captures of the October 22 and September 24 regular and the September 24 and June 25 special agendas read 36, 33, 8, and 8 items. The board meets on the fourth Thursday at 4:00 PM, on the third in November and December.

reviews.implementation: The `file-links` type with `matchLabels`: links whose label matches the board's regular or special meeting (and not its minutes) are grouped by the label's date, agenda then packet. The `tfhd-board` layout reads the decimal outline (5.1, 14.2) from the agenda rather than the packet (`agendaBeforePacket`). Recordings come from the Tahoe Truckee Media playlist; the board meetings page gives the comment form and the schedule.

reviews.name: Olympic Valley Public Service District Board of Directors
reviews.issue: Requested on 2026-11-13: the district provides water, sewer, garbage, and fire service in Olympic Valley. Each meeting's agenda is a WordPress post of the custom type "agenda" ("Regular Board Meeting – Tuesday, October 27, 2026, 8:30 a.m."), whose page is the agenda: an ordered list lettered by the page's style, with nested items labeled B-1, D-1 ... and each item's board report PDF linked from it. The RSS feed of the post type carries only ten posts, and the district re-published several 2023 agendas in 2026.
reviews.nextStep: Keep live discovery from the REST collection. The Finance Committee meets before each board meeting on the board's own agenda; other committees (Personnel, Water and Sewer, Fire) post calendar entries without agendas and are not followed.

resolution.note: The site answered the project's fetcher on 2026-11-13 (curl from the same sandbox got HTTP 403 from its Cloudflare edge). Live discovery found all 11 board meetings of 2026 (10 regular, the January 15 special); all 11 agenda pages were captured with 5 to 50 items each, and the October 27 meeting's linked reports mapped 12 items (seven action items and five status reports). The meetings page gives the schedule: the last Tuesday at 8:30 a.m., in the third week in November and December 2026. The site mentions no livestream or recording.

reviews.implementation: The `meeting-post-feed` type reads the post type's WordPress REST collection (100 posts) as well as an RSS feed; each post's page is the meeting's one HTML document. A new structured HTML reader (`tahoe_ingest/html_ordered_list.py`) gives the list's parts and nested items with their printed labels, with no agenda layout. A new staff report rule, `ordered-list-item-reports`, maps an item to the PDF its entry links when the PDF is a board report naming the item's exhibit number and the meeting date.

reviews.name: Tahoe-Truckee Sanitation Agency Board of Directors
reviews.issue: The regional wastewater agency for North Tahoe and Truckee moved its website to CivicPlus; its old Drupal agenda paths (ttsa.ca.gov/sites/g/files/...) stop in April 2024. The Board of Directors page links a CivicClerk portal for agendas, packets, and minutes, and a YouTube channel for recordings. The portal's calendar also holds Finance Committee meetings, office holidays, and placeholder board meetings through May 2027.
reviews.nextStep: Keep live discovery. Staff memos in the packet name their item ("Item: VI.1."), so a packet rule could attach them; none reads them yet. The Finance Committee is not followed.

resolution.note: Added at the maintainer's request. The portal's event API answered on 2026-11-13; live captures of the September 16, September 24 (special workshop), October 21, and November 18, 2026 agendas read 10, 4, 13, and 14 items. Agenda layouts changed during 2026 (mixed-case sections until July, capitals since August, and two special meeting formats); the fixtures cover each. The YouTube channel's titles carry the meeting date in most cases; the event list links several recordings directly.

reviews.implementation: The existing `civicclerk` type, now windowed for scheduled runs (the unwindowed list starts at the portal's furthest-future placeholder) and taking a YouTube `externalMediaUrl` as the recording. Layouts `ttsa-board` (Roman-numbered section lines as headings, numbering restarting in each) and `ttsa-special`. The YouTube channel is in meeting-records.json.

reviews.name: Northstar Community Services District Board of Directors
reviews.issue: The district (fire, water, sewer, roads, and trails for Northstar) publishes on an EvoGov site. Its static "Board Meeting Agendas" page stops at May 20, 2026; the meeting dashboard loads each year's meetings, with agenda and packet links, from the site's /meetings/year_events/ endpoint. ncsd.ca.gov is the Nipomo Community Services District, not this one.
reviews.nextStep: Keep live discovery. The packet opens each item with an "AGENDA ITEM #5" cover page, so a packet rule could attach staff reports; none reads them yet. No meeting recordings were found on the district's site.

resolution.note: Added at the maintainer's request. The dashboard and its endpoint answered on 2026-11-13; live captures of the September 16 and October 21, 2026 agendas read 18 and 17 items, and all thirteen 2026 agendas posted so far parse with the layout. The November 18 agenda was not posted yet.

reviews.implementation: A new `evogov-meetings` discovery type (tahoe_ingest/file_discovery.py) reads the dashboard's calendar years and each year's event rows. The `northstar-csd-board` layout reads numbered items under capitalized headings, with lettered sub-items.
